title: Processing Rate Components
raw_text:
9/29/26, 9:47 AM

Processing Rate Components

Use

Conditional rates are only billed for the duration of a TOU exception. TOU exceptions are typically short in duration (< 1 day). TOU
exceptions can be observed for a specific time during conditional billing.

Rate Proration

During billing execution, the rates are first determined by rate determination and prorated for the billing period. In conditional
billing, this takes places for the basic rates as well as for the conditional rates. An additional proration takes place for the
conditional rates as they do not cover the entire billing period. The propration principle is based on the smallest to-the-day

container. The periods in these containers are processed as valid periods. Any other periods that do not contain TOU exceptions
are no longer taken into account in conditional billing.

The smallest to-the-day containers are determined as follows:

e Thestart of the to-the-day container is the day on which the TOU exception takes place. If the TOU exception ends on the
same day, the container contains one day only.

e Ifthe TOU exception lasts longer than one day, the end point of the container is the day on which the TOU exception ends.
The to-the-day container contains multiple days.

e If multiple TOU exceptions take place on the same day, the smallest to-the-day containers for the TOU exceptions are
grouped into one container. The container contains one day.

e If multiple TOU exceptions take place on consecutive days, and none of the exceptions last longer than one day, multiple
separate to-the-day containers are determined, each containing one day.

e If multiple TOU exceptions take place on consecutive days and the exceptions do last longer than one day so that one TOU
exception ends on the same day as another starts, the smallest to-the-day containers are grouped together. The start of
the grouped to-the-day container is the day on which the first TOU exception occurs; the end of the grouped to-the-day
container is the day on which the last TOU exception ends.

The following example illustrates the most important cases:
